subject: RivetHack maintainer sponsorship - promo & trial extension request
messages:
From: Sally Kim <sally@openinfra.org>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: RivetHack maintainer credits and short-term trial extension

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — I'm Sally, program lead for the upcoming RivetHack community sprint (Nov 14-15). We're coordinating a maintainers' track and would love Redwood to support by providing promotional credits and a short trial extension for project maintainers and contributors. A few quick details: 

- Event: RivetHack 2026 (virtual + hubs across NA/EU)
- Maintainers expected to participate in paid sessions / workshops: ~25 core maintainers + ~75 contributors
- Estimated short-term usage per maintainer for workshops (interactive runs + evals): ~40k tokens each -> ~1.0–1.5M tokens total
- Request: One-time promotional credit pool (to be distributed to maintainers) + trial extension for newly created accounts so maintainers can onboard without hitting trial expiry mid-event.

We typically run a small stipend for maintainers to offset compute costs; if Redwood can provide promo credits equivalent to a $3k–5k budget (or an equivalent token allotment) and a 60-day trial extension tied to the promo codes, that would cover the group and make logistics easier.

Attached is a rough usage_estimate.csv with per-maintainer numbers and the event page. Happy to join a quick call to walk through details.

Thanks for considering — this would be a high-visibility community activation and we'd highlight Redwood across our channels.

Cheers,
Sally Kim
Program Lead, RivetHack / OpenInfra
[sally@openinfra.org]

[Attachment: usage_estimate.csv (text/csv)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: RivetHack maintainer credits and short-term trial extension

Forwarding — RivetHack (Sally) asked for a promotional credit pool + a 60-day trial extension for maintainers (see original below). Looks like ~1.2M tokens requested overall.

Quick questions:
- Are we comfortable approving an in-kind sponsorship of this size from the Partner/Community program (or should this come out of marketing)?
- If yes, do we issue a single promo code for the event, or individual codes per account?
- Any limits per account we should enforce?

cc: Marcus — tagging you for approval. Laura — can you advise on marketing amplification (we should get comms prepared if we sign).

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: RivetHack maintainer credits and short-term trial extension

Olga — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the usage_estimate and event reach; RivetHack is a good fit for our community program. I'm ok approving an in-kind promo allocation with the following guardrails: 

- Allocate a promo pool equivalent to ~3,000,000 input/output tokens (this provides headroom beyond their 1.2M estimate) — ballpark ~$4k at our hosted unit rates.
- Issue a single event code (RIVETHACK-2026-R4) that can be redeemed by maintainers; limit redemption to new accounts only and cap redemptions to one per account.
- Trial extension: grant a 60-day activation extension tied to code redemption (starts when code is used).
- Per-account cap: 100k token redemption max per account.

We should have Legal sign a short sponsorship agreement / MOU. I'll attach a one-page draft and we can route for signature (DocuSign). If we need to tie this to a HubSpot record, use HSP-8721.

Marcus
Head, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: draft_sponsorship_agreement.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: RivetHack maintainer credits and short-term trial extension

All — sounds good. A couple of operational notes from marketing/sales: 

- We should request a simple co-marketing blurb (event copy + logo usage) in exchange for the promo to get comms value. I'll draft a short blurb and push to Partnerships for approval.
- HubSpot tracking: I'll attach the landing link and ensure UTM tags for the promo code; HubSpot deal HSP-8721 will be the place to track conversions.
- For the cap: recommend 75k tokens/account to encourage broader distribution (keeps more people participating).

If Legal signs off on the draft, we can issue the code and send them the DocuSign link; propose we also provide a short FAQ for maintainers with redemption steps and common troubleshooting items.

Laura Bennett
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

[Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HSP-8721]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sally Kim <sally@openinfra.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RivetHack maintainer credits and short-term trial extension

Hi Sally — great to connect, and thanks for the detailed request. Happy to confirm Redwood will sponsor RivetHack maintainers with promotional credits and a trial extension. Summary of what we can offer: 

- Promo pool: event promo code RIVETHACK-2026-R4 (single event code) representing ~3,000,000 tokens total.
- Per-account cap: 75k tokens redeemed per account; limit one redemption per account.
- Trial extension: 60-day activation extension tied to code redemption; extension applies to new accounts created for the event.
- DocuSign: we routed a short sponsorship agreement for signature (link below). Please have your organizer or legal rep sign the MOU so we can issue funds and the promo.

Operational items: 
- I'll attach the draft sponsorship_agreement.pdf and the usage_estimate you sent.
- Please confirm the event page copy and logo usage for our comms team. Laura will follow up on co-marketing assets and landing pages.
- HubSpot deal: HSP-8721 — I'll mark the activation once the code is issued so Sales/Marketing can track conversions.

Links & attachments:
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-REDACTED
- Attachment: draft_sponsorship_agreement.pdf (application/pdf)
- Attachment: usage_estimate.csv (text/csv)

If that all looks good, let me know who will sign the agreement on your side and we can send the DocuSign. We aim to issue the code within 48 hours of receiving the signed MOU.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
